relations.steps.type.range: Required enum: start | end | job | pickup | delivery. id is required for job/pickup/delivery; omitted for start/end.
constraints: start/end reference the vehicle start/end (no id); job references a job id; pickup/delivery reference a shipment step id (§3.8).
businessRules: An unsatisfiable relation over these steps flags all its tasks unassigned (§3.8).

type defines: Specifies the type of the step. The start and end step types have to be the first and last steps, respectively, in a relation. Please note that the type is mandatory when using the relations object.
Valid options: start, end, job, pickup, delivery. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: relations.steps.id, relations.type. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A step type value outside the enum -> 400 input validation failed (API Facts §4).

Positive: a delivery step referencing an existing shipment delivery id (§3.8).

Negative-infeasible: an unsatisfiable relation over these steps -> all its tasks unassigned (§3.8).

constraints: Required for job/pickup/delivery steps; omitted for start/end steps (§3.8).
